title: spec-ambiguity: slug derivation when fix_signal branch already exists not prescribed
description: When fix_signal creates an implementation branch before calling start_spec, the spec agent must infer the slug from the existing fix_branch field to avoid creating a conflicting branch in Phase 11. spec.skill.md Phase 2 (Author) does not prescribe this inference — the agent must improvise it from contextual awareness of the session branch name. Future agents may choose a different slug and cause a branch conflict.
proposed_resolution: Add a note to spec.skill.md Phase 2: if the session context contains a fix_branch value (format feat/<domain>-<slug>), parse domain and slug from it and use those as the spec frontmatter values. This converts an undocumented assumption into a prescribed step.
